meaning.en: Any radio frequency between 3 and 30 megahertz.

meaning.en: (radio) The frequency area from 3 MHz through 30 MHz, commonly used for radio broadcasting.

meaning.en: Of or pertaining to high frequency sound or other radiation.

sentences.en: In constructing a hot-wire instrument for the measurement of high frequency currents it is necessary to make the working wire of a number of fine wires placed in parallel and slightly separated from one another, and to rpass the whole of the current to be measured through this strand.
sentences.vi: Trong cấu tạo một thiết bị dây nóng để đo dòng điện tần số cao, cần phải làm cho dây làm việc của một số dây mảnh được đặt song song và cách xa nhau một chút, và để chạy qua toàn bộ dòng điện cần đo. sợi này.

sentences.en: Thus pitch is a soft and yielding body under steady stress, but a bar of pitch if struck gives a musical note, which shows that it vibrates and is therefore stiff or elastic for high frequency stress.

sentences.en: He confirmed an opinion already previously expressed by Helmholtz and by Henry, that in some circumstances this discharge is oscillatory in nature, consisting of an alternating electric current of high frequency.
